title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 57  An Act Transferring the Seat of Government of the Municipality of Sitangkai, Province of Tawi-Tawi, to Sibutu Proper, Barangay Sibutu.

text.en:
The seat of government of the Municipality of Sitangkai, Province of Taw-Tawi, is hereby
transferred from Sitangkai Island to Sibutu Proper, Barangay Sibutu.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 1, 1980
